sources.snippet: AI Self-Talk: Internal Speech Enhances Multitask Learning and Generalization Researchers at OIST found that training AI to generate self-directed inner speech alongside working memory lets it generalize across novel tasks using far less data, pointing to training procedures, not just architecture size, as a key driver of capability.
